In the heart of the campground, beneath a sky painted with stars, a thousand voices rose—no, not a single one, but a thousand thunderous chords from the mountains. And yet, in that stillness, a heartbeat of something far more beautiful stirred.

This is the story of *Luna*, the quiet romance of two souls meeting in the dark, one after another. And so, in the same hush, two strangers meet—each other in the glow of a festival where music takes flight.

Welcome to *Festival of the Lost Voices*—a novel set in the wilds of the modern world, where the heartbeats of the night merge into one another,
